request: Add to Streak a command sortByName, titled "Sort by name", that sorts the habit list by name (state.sort to "name"), on the shortcut Cmd+Shift+O (mod+shift+o). Write it in Lisp, as a defcommand and a defkey in the program's habits.lisp.

add./program/habits.lisp/sortByName:
(defcommand sortByName "Sorts the habits by name." :title "Sort by name" :category "View"
  [] (set "state.sort" "name"))
